# Veyvox 1.17.15

## Saved messages, sticker albums and call history

- **Bookmarks.** Save any message for later from its hover bar or menu. The
  list shows what became of each original: edited, deleted or unavailable.
- **Sticker albums.** A personal library in Settings with private albums
  plus your sticker collection, and one shared album per space in Space
  Settings. The picker shows every album as tabs; store packs are unchanged.
- **DM call history.** Each call writes a single timeline card (ringing,
  active, ended, missed, rejected, cancelled) with its duration. A 1-on-1
  with one member left waits five minutes for a rejoin, with a countdown
  in the DM header, instead of ending at once. The DM list shows running
  calls.
- **Games picker.** The dialog lists Juno next to the announced Jolf, Juns
  and Jace, marked as coming soon.
- **Voice quality per channel.** Admins can set a voice channel to 64, 128
  or 256 kbps; the live microphone follows without a republish.
- **Instance camera policy.** New camera settings bound what members
  publish (fixed default or member choice within resolution, framerate and
  bitrate limits).

## Sending and storage

- Photos shrink before uploading (longest side 2560, EXIF including GPS
  dropped); videos re-encode up to 720p when WebCodecs can do it smaller.
  Anything that cannot be improved goes up untouched, and a failure is
  never an upload error.
- **Automatic disk cleanup** (off by default, Settings > Storage): when
  the disk fills past the threshold, the instance first deletes files
  nothing uses, then old chat attachments, oldest first, never newer than
  the floor. The message text stays.

## Upgrade notice

**Back up the database and uploads before upgrading.** This release adds
database migrations 0051–0055 (bookmarks, disk-cleanup settings, sticker
scopes, voice bitrate, camera limits) and deletes nothing: sticker packs
created before this release keep working as store packs. To roll back,
stop the application and restore the matching pre-upgrade backup; do not
run an older server against a migrated database. Desktop
signing/platform limitations remain unchanged. Publishing this release
does not itself deploy it.

## Português (Brasil)

A 1.17.15 traz **favoritos** (salve qualquer mensagem e veja o que
aconteceu com o original), **álbuns de figurinhas** (álbuns privados
seus + um álbum por espaço, com abas no seletor), **histórico de
chamadas no DM** (um cartão por chamada, com duração, e espera de 5
minutos quando só resta uma pessoa), a telinha de **jogos** com Juno ao
lado de Jolf, Juns e Jace (em breve), **qualidade de voz por canal**
(64/128/256 kbps) e **política de câmera da instância**. Fotos
encolhem antes de subir e vídeos são re-codificados até 720p quando dá
para ficarem menores. A **limpeza automática de disco** (desligada por
padrão, em Configurações > Armazenamento) libera espaço sozinha quando o
disco enche, primeiro apagando arquivos sem uso e depois mídias antigas
do chat.

**Faça backup do banco e dos uploads antes de atualizar.** Esta versão
adiciona as migrações 0051–0055 e não apaga nada: packs criados antes
continuam funcionando como packs da loja. Para voltar atrás, pare a
aplicação e restaure o backup correspondente; não rode um servidor
antigo contra um banco migrado.
